items.q: Can you supply generation without a loop?
items.a: We confirm the configuration when you enquire. Generation is PVC pretreatment, RO and EDI, feeding your tank, process or equipment directly. Electrolyser feed and boiler make-up rarely need a loop.

items.q: Does RO replace our boiler water treatment?
items.a: No. RO supplies make-up water to the limit your boiler maker sets. Chemical treatment and blowdown stay with your treatment program.

items.q: Our process has no written water limit. Where do we start?
items.a: With where the water goes and what fails when it is wrong. An engineer drafts the limit with you: parameter, unit, stage and sampling point. You approve it before design starts.

No. Lines under good manufacturing practice (GMP) add qualification documents to the package. Not under GMP? The same stages apply, with commissioning and an acceptance test against your specification in place of qualification.

items.q: We pay for exchange DI. When does our own RO and EDI make sense?
items.a: Send your daily use and what exchange costs you today. We compare the two in writing.
